strategy: Spam Blessed Hammer while maintaining Arbiter of Justice form by regularly activating Falling Star and Condemn. Prioritize weapon upgrades, use War Plans activities like Helltides and Pit runs, and raise difficulty as damage scales to maximize XP before level 70. Note: the guide describes phases ('branches gradually unlock at specific level thresholds') without giving most exact numbers.

paragon.note: Under Paragon 200, use the Board Rush setup for max legendary-node power, then respec into the Step 1 setup. Glyph priorities are consistent across Endgame/Push variants. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
